report_name: ZaWoo Ransomware Claims Attack on French Accounting Firm

threat_actors.name: ZaWoo
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that engages in double-extortion tactics by infiltrating networks, exfiltrating data, encrypting files, and then publicly listing non-paying victims on its data leak site to pressure them into paying a ransom.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Cited as a highly probable initial access vector for the attack on Agiliance, where an employee clicking a malicious link or opening a weaponized document could provide the initial foothold.

attack_patterns.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
attack_patterns.description: Mentioned as a likely post-access step for attackers to escalate privileges to a domain administrator to map the network.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Used by the ZaWoo group to exfiltrate large amounts of data from the victim's network before encryption as part of their double-extortion model.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The ZaWoo ransomware payload is deployed to encrypt servers and workstations, disrupting the victim's ability to operate.

attack_patterns.name: System Owner/User Discovery
attack_patterns.description: The use of 'whoami /groups' was suggested as a hunting hint to detect attacker activity aimed at understanding user permissions.

malware.name: ZaWoo
malware.description: The ransomware payload deployed by the ZaWoo group to encrypt servers and workstations as part of a double-extortion scheme.

identities.name: Agiliance
identities.description: A French accounting and business advisory firm, composed of eight accounting practices, listed as a victim on the ZaWoo ransomware group's data leak site.

indicators.name: ZaWoo Ransom Note File
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: ZaWoo Ransom Note Creation
id: 2b9f3c1a-8d7e-4f6b-9c1d-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of the ZaWoo ransom note file 'zawoo-readme.txt'.
references:
  - https://www.galaxywarden.com/blog/breach/agiliance-fr-zawoo-2026-09
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\zawoo-readme.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of the ZaWoo ransom note file 'zawoo-readme.txt', which was listed as a cyber observable.

indicators.name: Suspicious User Permission Discovery via Whoami
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious User Permission Discovery via Whoami
id: 5e8a1b4c-9d0f-4a3b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 'whoami /groups' command, which can be used by attackers to understand user permissions after gaining initial access.
references:
  - https://www.galaxywarden.com/blog/breach/agiliance-fr-zawoo-2026-09
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
  - attack.t1033
level: low
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\whoami.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '/groups'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of the 'whoami /groups' command, which was suggested as a hunting hint for detecting attacker discovery activity.

indicators.name: ZaWoo Ransomware File Encryption

references:

author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.[zawoo]'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects files being created with the `.[zawoo]` extension, a strong indicator of ZaWoo ransomware encryption.
